title: 2011 Peyton Transition Report - Chapter on Office of the Sheriff
key_finding: The City says the Office of the Sheriff was established to bring all City of Jacksonville and Duval County law enforcement under one entity, while the three beach communities and Baldwin retained separate police departments.

title: City of Jacksonville Official Statement / General Information on the City of Jacksonville, Florida
key_finding: The consolidated government extends throughout Duval County and provides police protection through the consolidated structure while specifically excluding the Beaches Communities and the Town of Baldwin from those municipal-service carve-ins.

title: Jacksonville Sheriff's Office Homepage
key_finding: JSO states that its vision is to serve the citizens of Duval County, consistent with a consolidated city-county primary law-enforcement role.

title: FDLE County and Municipal Offense Data 2019
key_finding: FDLE lists Jacksonville Sheriff's Office as the main Duval local row in 2019 and separately lists Atlantic Beach, Jacksonville Beach, and Neptune Beach.

title: FDLE County and Municipal Offense Data 2020
key_finding: FDLE again lists Jacksonville Sheriff's Office as the main Duval local row in 2020 and separately lists the beach municipalities.

title: FDLE County and Municipal Offense Data 2021
key_finding: After the FBI summary transition, FDLE still lists Jacksonville Sheriff's Office as the main Duval local row and keeps the beach municipalities separate, which supports continuity of the same consolidated Jacksonville policing surface.
